method: fresh pinned source inspection and manual control-flow audit; no new compiled native execution
conclusions: GetIterator resolves comparator-equivalent stored child, including a distinct object with the same text-node index.
RemoveChild rejects phantom arguments before lookup or callback.
Successful lookup detaches pRemove, moves its descendants to predecessor or first phantom, invalidates and notifies transferred subtree, adjusts last-valid before erase and then notifies root suffix.
After phantom creation the lookup iterator is recomputed using the supplied argument.
PostRemove is invoked on pChild, not pRemove, after successful removal or a real-argument miss.
Shown SwNodeNum PostRemove removes comparator-equivalent document registry membership, removes its bound-rule text client and clears only its own bound rule.
Document registry already uses equivalence locally; no registry implementation change required.
Native RemoveTextNode may invalidate the owning list when the rule remains invalid; tests validate the rule before measuring removal callback order.
limitations: Source inspection and actual local-owner regression tests do not establish compiled native owner/layout/destructor/redline lifetime parity.
